# Chapter 1: Numbers Around Us
pages 1-12

## Numbers and Counting Part 1
pages 1-2

Students learn to recognise and write numbers from one to twenty, connecting each numeral to a matching count of familiar objects such as fruits and toys.

### Writing numeral 1
Trace and copy the numeral while saying its name aloud, then count objects to match. (reading_skill, p1)

### Writing numeral 2
Trace and copy the numeral while saying its name aloud, then count objects to match. (writing_skill, p1)

### Writing numeral 3
Trace and copy the numeral while saying its name aloud, then count objects to match. (recognition_skill, p1)

#### Exercises
- [writing_practice] Look at the picture of the basket and count the mangoes, then write the correct numeral in the box provided beside it. (p1)
- [art_activity] Look at the picture of the basket and count the mangoes, then write the correct numeral in the box provided beside it. (p1)
- [matching_exercise] Look at the picture of the basket and count the mangoes, then write the correct numeral in the box provided beside it. (p1)
- [reading_exercise] Look at the picture of the basket and count the mangoes, then write the correct numeral in the box provided beside it. (p1)

#### Sidebars
- Did you know? Counting on your fingers is one of the oldest ways people learned numbers. (p1)
